value.rationale: A natural complete statistical-mechanics invariant (all 33 energy-level degeneracies for the 32-spin fully frustrated Q5) is given in a concise three-term closed formula; this determines all-temperature zero-field behavior, optimizer multiplicity and the first excitation, far beyond the already-known minimum frustration count.
